line.note: a problem at a line of the MJML source; problem is one of the parse.* or lint.* messages, or the compiler's own words (English)

parse.unclosedComment.note: an MJML syntax problem, after "Line 3: "; lower case

parse.noOpeningTag.note: tag: an MJML or HTML tag name, mj-section

parse.unclosedTag.note: tag: an MJML tag name, mj-section

parse.unfinishedTag.note: the source ends inside the tag's attributes

parse.unclosedQuote.note: an attribute value's quote is never closed

parse.noRoot.note: <mjml> is the MJML root tag: keep it as it is

lint.columns.message: the columns of this section add up to {sum}; MJML squeezes them and the layout shifts. Make them add up to {full}.

lint.imageWidth.message: mj-image width {width}px exceeds the {column} column ({columnPx}px); it will be scaled down. Set width="{fitPx}px" or remove it.
lint.imageWidth.note: column: the column's width as written, 50% or 300px; width="…px" is the attribute to write: keep it as it is

section.header.note: names of an email's sections, in lower case, as the composer's layer tree names them (web: composer canvas.messages sec*): "An image in the header section"

section.columns.note: a section of columns side by side: 2 columns
